key_takeaways: A Bali wedding package bundles ceremony and reception elements for a set guest number and time window; read every quote line by line, because inclusions vary by provider.
The items to check before you sign are the ones a wedding week depends on: guest rooms and room blocks, transfers, a wet-season space, extra events, overtime, service and tax, and legal paperwork.

Our packages page, which includes our three Bali packages (Akohara Buahan, Regent Bali Canggu and The Apurva Kempinski), lists guest accommodation and legal documentation as paid separately; ask for an itemised quote.

For a legal Indonesian wedding, the Australian Embassy, citing Law No. 1 of 1974, says both partners must hold the same religion or one must convert; marrying in Australia first and celebrating in Bali avoids that step.
Compare packages in one currency, on the same guest number, with the wet-season plan, payment schedule and cancellation terms side by side.

faq.q: What is usually included in a Bali wedding package?
faq.a: The ceremony, a reception window, food and drink tiers, styling and on-day coordination, built around a set guest number. With Wedded Wonderland, the specific inclusions for each property are sent after you enquire with your date and approximate guest count, and your shortlist sets out inclusions, dates and pricing for each option.

faq.q: Are all inclusive Bali wedding packages really all inclusive?
faq.a: They include the bundle they name, not the whole trip. Our own packages page lists extras such as spa, excursions or additional events as paid separately, on request. Read what all-inclusive wedding packages really cost before you treat any label as a total.

faq.q: How much should we budget for a luxury Bali wedding?
faq.a: It depends on guest numbers, the number of events, the season and the venue type, so a package price alone will not answer it. Our Bali cost guide sets out budgets for a 100-guest wedding, with figures in USD, so convert them to AUD on the day you compare.

faq.q: Is a Bali wedding legally recognised in Australia?
faq.a: A legal Indonesian marriage generally is. Smartraveller's advice on marrying overseas says you cannot register an overseas marriage in Australia, but it is usually recognised if valid where it happened and would be valid under Australian law, except where either person was already married, not old enough, too closely related or forced to marry.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book a Bali wedding package?
faq.a: Our packages page puts the comfortable lead time for destination weddings at this level at 12 to 18 months, and says shorter timelines are workable in less seasonal regions. If you are marrying legally in Bali, plan on a CNI issued within three months of the wedding: the Australian Embassy says local Civil Registry Offices do not normally accept older ones.
